# Savyre AI Coding Workflow (GitHub Copilot)

This project uses the Savyre structured workflow for AI-assisted development.

- Respect the current stage in `.savyre/stage-status.json`.
- Follow `AGENTS.md` and `SAVYRE_INSTRUCTIONS.md`.
- Save stage work under `savyre/stages/<stage-id>/`.
- Do not skip validation or review steps.
- Avoid unrelated file changes outside the approved plan.
